details: Ethereum (ETH) price surged by 3% to trade above $1,900 after cooling US inflation data improved risk appetite among investors. The rebound saw ETH reclaim key moving averages, strengthening its short-term recovery.
title: Ethereum Rebounds as CPI Cools

details: Bitcoin (BTC) retreated below $64,000 following July's US inflation data, which landed exactly in line with forecasts. Analysts suggest this gives the Federal Reserve flexibility but offers little immediate catalyst for Bitcoin to break out of its multi-week trading range.
title: Bitcoin Dips Under $64K After In-Line CPI

details: The US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is reportedly preparing two significant crypto initiatives, including a tailored offering regime for certain crypto investment contracts and an innovation exemption for trading tokenized stocks. This could allow 24/7 trading of digital securities on blockchain networks.
title: SEC Plans Crypto Investment Regime, Tokenized Stock Exemption

details: Coinbase has secured regulatory approval in Abu Dhabi to build an international hub for tokenized securities. This initiative aims to bring traditional stocks onto blockchain networks outside the United States, offering a supervised base for these digital assets.
title: Coinbase Establishes Abu Dhabi Hub for Tokenized Stocks

details: Pi Network (PI) price rose over 5% on August 12, approaching $0.090. The increase coincided with cooling US inflation data and the passing of the Protocol 26 upgrade deadline, supporting speculative asset performance.
title: Pi Network Gains 5% Following CPI Data and Upgrade

details: Uniswap (UNI) is under intense selling pressure, dropping nearly 6% on Wednesday, extending a 5% loss from the previous day. Despite the launch of Continuous Clearing Auctions on Avalanche, declining retail demand and social interest indicate a risk-off sentiment.
title: Uniswap Faces Steeper Decline Amid Bearish Signals

details: Anchorpoint, a venture backed by Standard Chartered, has commenced the rollout of its HKDAP stablecoin in Hong Kong. This follows regulatory approval and aims to facilitate cross-border payments and tokenized asset use through a B2B2C model.
title: Standard Chartered-Backed Anchorpoint Begins HKDAP Stablecoin Rollout

details: Wintermute, a major crypto market maker, plans to invest $1 billion over the next five years into high-frequency trading and AI data centers. This announcement has led to gains in top AI coins like Bittensor and Near Protocol, despite a generally bearish broader market.
title: Wintermute Plans $1B Investment in AI, Boosting AI Crypto Tokens
